**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, gateway, applied 2026-03-14T02:13:41Z) flipped config `gateway.pool.perRequest: false → true`. Connections stopped returning to the shared pool between requests, so the pool (fixed size 20) exhausted fast. Every failure since is the same pair:

```
ERROR access  reqXXXXX /v1/... -> <svc> 503 <ms>ms
ERROR pool    reqXXXXX ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```

`in_use` pins at 20; `waiting` climbs from 13 to 74 with no recovery.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14T02:14:18Z through the end of available logs (03:59:27Z) — still failing when the log ends. 530 requests hit 503 in that span. Workers (`worker.log`, same window) show zero errors, so this stayed gateway-only.

**Rollback:** revert `dep-4471` — set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false` (config generation 119 → 118).
